label: First input is d/c/u (plus first copy-step of length-3 sequences)
explanation: Update-gate unit 24 fires mainly at step 0 when the first input token is d, c or u: it fires on every such step, and these hold about 84% of activation mass. Magnitude depends on the token: d is about 0.53 of max, u about 0.20, c about 0.08. A second, weaker mode fires at step L+1 in length-3 sequences (the step after <DEL>, where the first original token is fed back and the second is output). It fires on about 57% of those steps and gives the largest activations overall (up to max, especially when the fed-back token is d). It also fires weakly at step 1 when the input is d. It does not fire on the delimiter, at steps 2-3 or 6+, in copy phases with L>3, or on other first tokens. Dev F1 0.91, mass recall 0.97.

issues: The factual claims hold. The t==0 & in_tok in {d,c,u} clause has precision 1.0, recall 0.79 and mass 0.84. Copy-phase activity at recall_idx==1 occurs only for L==3 (the L>3 version gets 0 recall). The unit never fires on the delimiter, at t=2-3, or at t>=6.

Systematic gap 1: the 'weak step-1 d' mode is left out of the predicate, but a simple rule decides it. At t==1 with in_tok==d, the unit fires every time when prev_tok is in {e,g,k,o,p,q,t,z,1,3} (precision 1.0 for each of these tokens) and never for any other prev_tok. These are about 1,126 dev actives (8.8% of recall), and they are the whole missed set in --split test misses.

Systematic gap 2: the claim 'could not find what separates active from inactive' in the L==3 recall_idx==1 mode is refuted. The fed-back token in_tok (= orig(0)) largely decides it. Precision is about 1.0 for in_tok in c, d, f, u and w, about 0.9 for n and q, and about 0.02-0.08 for g, j and z. The predicate's false positives (1,107 on test, all at step 4 with L=3) concentrate on these low-rate fed-back tokens.
The label understates the structure: both secondary modes are determined by tokens, not left unexplained or 'weak'.
skeptic.revised_label: Fires at step 0 when the first token is d, c or u. Also fires at step 1 on d after particular first tokens, and at the first copy step of length-3 sequences depending on the fed-back first token.
skeptic.better_predicate: ((t == 0) & isin(in_tok, [tok("d"), tok("c"), tok("u")])) | ((t==1)&(in_tok==tok("d"))&isin(prev_tok,[tok(c) for c in "egkopqtz13"])) | ((L==3)&(recall_idx==1)&isin(in_tok,[tok(c) for c in "acdfiknopqsuvw12"]))

final_label: Fires at step 0 when the first token is d, c or u. Also fires at step 1 on d after particular first tokens, and at the first copy step of length-3 sequences depending on the fed-back first token.
